class Holder<Out = string> {
  constructor(public value: Out) {}

  describe(): Out {
    return this.value;
  }
}

class DefaultHolder extends Holder {}

class NumberHolder extends Holder<number> {
  double(): number {
    return this.value * 2;
  }
}

class ListHolder<U> extends Holder<U[]> {
  first(): U {
    return this.value[0];
  }
}

class Pair<T, U = T[]> {
  constructor(
    public first: T,
    public rest: U
  ) {}
}

class NumberPair extends Pair<number> {}

const text: string = new DefaultHolder("hello").value;
const described: string = new DefaultHolder("world").describe();
const base: Holder<string> = new DefaultHolder("base");
type IsStringHolder = DefaultHolder extends Holder<string> ? true : false;
const isStringHolder: IsStringHolder = true;
const doubled: number = new NumberHolder(21).double();
const first: number = new ListHolder([7, 8]).first();
const rest: number[] = new NumberPair(1, [2, 3]).rest;
console.log(text, described, base.value, isStringHolder);
console.log(doubled, first, rest.join(","));
